# CollectionAPI

[USD](glossary.md#usd) collections, applied as CollectionAPI:<name>. The parser resolves a collection to the includes targets expanded through their descendants, minus the excludes subtrees. It does so for the colliders collection of a PhysicsCollisionGroup and the quasistaticactors collection of PhysxSceneQuasistaticAPI.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable), [`Imageable`](glossary.md#imageable), [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Multi-apply:** applied as `CollectionAPI:<instance>`; `<inst>` in a column name is the instance. Instances: any instance name.
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**

## What USD population writes

Authored includes and excludes relationships are published like any relationship. [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) also lists the bare name CollectionAPI next to every CollectionAPI:<name> entry.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the USD schema value. *Producer writes* is what ovstage population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `collection:<inst>:includes` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | Empty collection. |
| `collection:<inst>:excludes` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | Nothing is pruned. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysicsCollisionGroup`](PhysicsCollisionGroup.md):** Reads the colliders instance; that component lists collection:colliders:includes and :excludes as its own columns.
- **[`PhysxSceneQuasistaticAPI`](PhysxSceneQuasistaticAPI.md):** Reads the quasistaticactors instance on the scene, only when that API is applied; the compiled cache does not support that API, so a Stage using it bypasses the cache.

## Notes

- expansionRule, includeRoot and membershipExpression are not read: includes always expand to all descendants.
- Instance names are arbitrary, so the compiled cache declares every collection:* column.
